conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "rami-api" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"

documentation.content: Sustained 5xx responses from rami-api. Check recent deploy, error logs (severity>=ERROR), and Cloud SQL. The API returns generic 5xx text; correlate by correlation id in logs. Runbook: docs/monitoring.md.
